dispatch.title: Dispatch board
dispatch.lead: The jobs matching gives to couriers, newest first. Step in by hand: give a waiting job to a courier, take a job off its courier, or cancel a job no order is waiting for.
dispatch.keys.label: Keys on this page
dispatch.filter.label: Find on this page
dispatch.filter.description: A job, order or air waybill number.
dispatch.filter.none: No job on this page matches.
dispatch.list.title: Jobs
dispatch.idle.title: Nothing chosen
dispatch.idle.body: Choose a job to see it on the map, give it to a courier, take it back or cancel it.
dispatch.map.label: Map of job {id}
dispatch.timeline.title: Timeline
dispatch.courier.title: Courier
dispatch.courier.notTracked: Matching does not track courier {id} right now: their app is not connected.
dispatch.courier.toPickup: {distance} from the pickup in a straight line
dispatch.bound: This job belongs to order {order}, so it is cancelled with the order, not here.
dispatch.assign.title: Couriers near the pickup
dispatch.assign.lead: Nearest first, as matching measures them. Only an online courier can take the job. Your choice overrides the two checks automatic dispatch makes: the courier's capacity against the job's weight, and the age of their last position.
dispatch.assign.none: No tracked courier within {distance} of the pickup.
dispatch.assign.notOnline: Only an online courier can take a job.
dispatch.confirm.assign.title: Give job {job} to courier {courier}?
dispatch.confirm.assign.body: Matching tells the courier's app at once. The courier was {distance} from the pickup when matching last measured.
dispatch.confirm.unassign.title: Take job {job} off courier {courier}?
dispatch.confirm.unassign.body: The job goes back to waiting, for matching to offer again or for you to assign. Matching tells the courier's app.
dispatch.confirm.cancel.title: Cancel job {job}?
dispatch.confirm.cancel.body: A cancelled job cannot be resumed. If a courier holds it, matching tells their app.
dispatch.report.madeAfterAll: Matching failed while it was writing, but the job was read again and the change was made.
dispatch.report.unchanged: Matching failed while it was writing. The job was read again: it is unchanged, so nothing was done.
dispatch.report.unread: Matching failed while it was writing, and the job could not be read again. Read it before trying again.
dispatch.failure.notFound: Matching has no such job any more.
dispatch.failure.alreadyAssigned: Another courier was given this job first. The job was read again.
dispatch.failure.driverNotTracked: Courier {courier} is not tracked right now: their app is not connected.
dispatch.failure.driverUnavailable: Courier {courier} is no longer online: busy, or off duty.
dispatch.failure.notAssigned: No courier holds this job any more: it is already waiting.
dispatch.failure.invalidTransition: The job has moved on: a picked-up, delivered or cancelled job cannot be changed this way. It was read again.
dispatch.failure.boundToOrder: Matching refused: this job belongs to an order, and only the order can cancel it.
dispatch.failure.invalidNearby: Matching could not read the pickup's coordinates, so no courier was looked up.
dispatch.proof.title: Proof of delivery
dispatch.proof.photoAlt: The photo the courier took at the drop-off of job {job}
dispatch.proof.photoBroken: The photo could not be shown: its link lasts fifteen minutes, or the storage host refused it.
dispatch.proof.signatureAlt: The signature of the recipient of job {job}
dispatch.proof.signatureUnreadable: The signature could not be drawn: it is not a PNG image.
